short.en: Frederick II is crowned Holy Roman Emperor in Rome by Pope Honorius III.
short.zh: 腓特烈二世在罗马由教皇霍诺留三世加冕为神圣罗马帝国皇帝。

short.en: In Paris, Jean-François Pilâtre de Rozier and François Laurent d'Arlandes make the first untethered hot air balloon flight.
At least 28 are wounded after a bomb is thrown onto a bus in Tel Aviv.
short.zh: 特拉维夫一辆巴士被投掷炸弹，造成至少28人受伤。

short.en: The US Secretary of Defence says Venezuela has "gone from our most aggressive regional threat to a compliant security partner".
The Mrima Hill site is estimated to hold deposits of critical minerals worth more than $60bn (£45bn).
To be, or not to be, that is the question.
short.zh: 生存还是毁灭，这是一个值得思考的问题。
short.note: 莎剧名句；question 重音在前；朗读时在逗号处停顿。

short.en: A truck driver's fortunes have changed overnight after he won a Diwali lottery in the northern Indian state of Punjab.
Anglo-French blockade of the Río de la Plata: Battle of Vuelta de Obligado.
The beloved hippopotamus died days after swallowing a knitted hat that accidentally got into her enclosure at the Cincinnati Zoo.
The worst part of success is trying to find someone who is happy for you.
Thinking is the capital, enterprise is the way, hard work is the solution.
A mathematician at Anthropic says he used an AI to prove the famed Riemann hypothesis, though verification will take some time.
short.zh: Anthropic的一位数学家表示，他使用人工智能证明了著名的黎曼猜想，但验证还需要一些时间。

short.en: Everything in the universe is within you. Ask all from yourself.
If you like your brother and he's prospering, you'll be pleased for him.
Carys Douglas, 23, made her stage debut this year in Anton Chekhov's play, The Seagull, in the US.
short.zh: 23岁的卡莉丝·道格拉斯（Carys Douglas）今年在美国首次登台演出安东·契诃夫（Anton Chekhov）的戏剧《海鸥》（The Seagull）。

short.en: The BBC’s Laura Bicker, Steve Rosenberg and Nada Tawfik explain everything you need to know ahead of the unprecedented trilateral meeting.
short.zh: BBC 的劳拉·比克 (Laura Bicker)、史蒂夫·罗森伯格 (Steve Rosenberg) 和纳达·陶菲克 (Nada Tawfik) 在这场史无前例的三边会议之前解释了您需要了解的一切。

short.en: A heart is not judged by how much you love, but by how much you are loved by others.
The Doom Bar in Cornwall claims two ships, Island Maid and Angele, the latter killing the entire crew except the captain.
European allies of Ukraine say they have a "united" negotiating position at a summit in Berlin.
Eating words has never given me indigestion.

long.en: The city is noisy and crowded in the morning, with buses and bikes filling every street. Still, I enjoy walking through the old neighborhoods, where small shops and cafes give the place a warm and friendly feeling.
long.zh: 早晨的城市嘈杂拥挤，公交车和自行车挤满每条街。不过我喜欢穿行在老街区，小店和咖啡馆让这里有种温暖亲切的氛围。
long.note: with 复合结构表伴随；where 定语从句；neighborhood 美音卷舌。

long.en: In your light I learn how to love. In your beauty, how to make poems. You dance inside my chest where no-one sees you, but sometimes I do, and that sight becomes this art.
Canadian journalist and politician William Lyon Mackenzie calls for a rebellion against the United Kingdom in his essay "To the People of Upper Canada", published in his newspaper The Constitution.
long.zh: 加拿大记者兼政治家威廉·里昂·麦肯齐在他的报纸《宪法》上发表的文章《致上加拿大人民》中呼吁反抗英国。
